claim: Simon Green: OU connection first, then the official citation, which stays as written.
note: this suggestion is great but leader isn't the right word, maybe PI?

suggestion.to: A main-belt asteroid named after Colin Pillinger (1943-2014), Professor at the Open University and leader of the Beagle 2 Mars lander. Its official naming citation reads: “Colin T. Pillinger (b. 1943), a planetary geochemist, made significant discoveries in the light-element geochemistry of meteorites, diamonds, lunar samples and terrestrial samples. He is the originator and principal investigator of the Beagle 2 Mars lander. The name was suggested by E. K. Gibson.” The shape model of this object is awaiting further study - and it may or may not be accurately represented in this visualisation.
